_comment: Registry of public competitive-programming calendar feeds. check_feeds.py fetches each one anonymously and records whether it is still being updated. Feeds marked recommended=true are the ones the website tells people to subscribe to -- if one of those dies, CI fails loudly rather than leaving a stale recommendation up.
_comment_horizon: min_horizon_days is how far ahead this feed normally has events. Platforms differ a lot: Codeforces announces months out, while LeetCode only ever publishes about two weeks ahead, so judging both by one threshold produces false alarms. A feed is 'stale' when its furthest future event is nearer than this.

feeds.name: codeforces.com
feeds.note: Community-run via clist.by. Not affiliated with Codeforces.

feeds.name: LeetCode Contests
feeds.note: Community-maintained import calendar. Not affiliated with LeetCode. LeetCode only schedules about two weeks ahead, so this feed is normally short.

feeds.name: Codechef Contest Calendar
feeds.note: The most widely linked CodeChef calendar. Scraper stopped running.
